notes: The tuition fact of 178 EUR/year is the French Licence-level fee that a Moroccan extra-communautaire student may pay only after exonération of the droits d'inscription différenciés; the pages say differentiated fees may otherwise apply and that some establishments exonerate foreign students. The Campus France Maroc page states the differentiated fee is 2 902 euros for a Licence year, but it is a general institution-wide figure for public higher education and may not apply to this specific programme. The requirement language quote comes from the general Campus France Maroc page about first-year licence (L1) applications; it is not on the programme's own page. The task explicitly says not to output applicationChannel for this programme.
